inclusion_rule: Decoders that transcribe or recognise speech from lip, face or articulator video (alone or with audio) and claim online, streaming, simultaneous or real-time operation, classified by whether the full text reports a measured latency, algorithmic delay or real-time factor and an online-scored error rate. Boundary: human-perception studies, speech enhancement or separation, talking-head synthesis and phonetic analyses are excluded on reading of the ledger text; reference-list mentions do not count; versions count once; Cai et al. 2011 (isca-cai11-lightssi) and a 2017 real-time lip vowel recogniser (doi-10.1109-access.2017.2649838) are added from the whole-wiki recall check.
